objective: Increase realized profitable revenue through a measured closed loop without bypassing truth consent identity quality legal safety contact-pressure dedupe or provider-readback gates.

gap_closer.rule: Every structural gap must be repaired automatically or materialized as an explicit canonical obligation. Unknown external outcomes are never fabricated.

gap_semantics: A structural gap is missing lineage, missing repair ownership or an eligible repair that is not represented canonically. A future customer/provider outcome may legitimately be pending, but it must have an explicit readback obligation and evidence lineage.
truth_boundary: No response, conversion, revenue, forecast success or experiment winner may be claimed until observed. The gap closer may make pending external truth explicit but may not manufacture it.
economic_truth: Realized revenue is only counted from observed outcomes. Optimize expected profitable value, not vanity metrics.
definition_of_done: A structural capability is operational only when every eligible gap is auto-repaired or explicitly owned with evidence. Commercial maturity still requires repeated real production cycles with observed outcomes calibration and reused learning.
prevention: Never create a parallel revenue attribution experiment sales content or learning system when these canonical routes can be extended; never hide an unknown external outcome by marking it successful or complete.
